name: Empty state
purpose: What a region says when it has nothing to show. Three postures: first-run (nothing exists yet — invite the first action with a primary button), no-results (a search/filter matched nothing — offer the cheap way back as a link), and quiet (legitimately nothing to do — say so and stop). Text-led with an optional real library glyph as a muted anchor; an empty state is a state, not an event.

props.name: title
props.$note: Carries the meaning (.t-ed-heading-4 .em); the glyph is decorative.

props.name: body
props.$note: One or two sentences, 0.6 ink (house caption treatment); explain and point forward, never blame.

props.name: glyph
props.$note: Optional REAL library glyph id (icon-source rule) at 48px, 0.4 ink, aria-hidden.

props.name: action
props.$note: ONE action max: primary button (first-run) or link (no-results). Quiet takes none.

variants.name: first-run
variants.use: Nothing exists yet; the primary button starts the first item ('Add a payee').

variants.name: no-results
variants.use: Filter/search empty; a LINK clears it — the way back is cheap, not a commitment.

variants.name: quiet
variants.use: All caught up; title + one line, no action.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — title .t-ed-heading-4 .em; body .t-ed-body-small; button .t-cm-button + .t-cm-slot
tokens.frame: border/subtle DASHED + border-radius/surface (reads as 'reserved space', distinct from a card's solid border)
tokens.glyph: text/default at 0.4 ink, 48px — real assets only (informative/task, global-controls/search); NO spot-illustration set exists (icon gap logged in receipt)
tokens.action: canon Button mirror under .ebtn (namespaced — the .btn type.css blast radius must not escape): button/primary/* with the 0.70 color-mix hover (ADR-0009/B-D3)

motion.entry: None — an empty state is already there when the region renders.
motion.reducedMotion: Nothing to reduce beyond the standard collapse.

responsive.rule: Centred column, max 480px, fluid below; copy max 40ch; padding 48/24 holds to small sizes.

mustNotNeighbour: Skeleton loader (loading and empty are different claims — never both)
A second action (an empty region is not a menu)

accessibility.role: A labelled <section aria-labelledby> — no live region: state, not event (nothing announces).
accessibility.name: The title is the region's accessible name; glyphs aria-hidden.
accessibility.keyboard: The single action/link is tabbable and Enter/Space-operable.
accessibility.nonText: The glyph conveys nothing (decorative, sub-3:1 by design at 0.4 ink); meaning is entirely in the text.

antiPatterns: A skeleton where the truth is 'empty' (loading is a different claim)
Multiple actions or a button where a link suffices (no-results wants the cheap way back)
Blame copy ('You have no…' reads as fault; say what can happen next)
An invented illustration (icon-source rule — real assets only; the spot-illustration set is a logged gap)
Announcing the empty state via a live region (it is not an event)
Re-implementing press physics locally on the action (ADR-0013 ratchet)
